descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S02 「iOS 和 Android 商店 build：打包好的 app 里没有 provider 密钥」 iOS and Android store builds: no provider key in the packaged app

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And …（UAT OAT-05 step 1；TFA-94700 AC 5；TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1')；TFA-94423 AC 1）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given The TestFlight IPA and the Play internal AAB/APK that pilot physicians will install (build numbers from the 3.1 run record)

When Unpack both. Run the S01 patterns over the bundled web assets (public/), capacitor.config.json, Info.plist, AndroidManifest.xml, res/values/*.xml, and native plugin configs. Check that no GoogleService-Info.plist or google-services.json carries an API key.

Then No provider key or credential in either package. The native layer holds only the Convex URLs.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 1 and TFA-94700 AC 5 ('anywhere in the app'), on iOS and Android. Any match is a Fail, quoted with the platform, file and key type (value masked).

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S02 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：STATIC · 静态检查（构建产物 / 扫描）；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。

Detail:

What can be checked without the store artefacts: the mobile web bundle (vite --mode mobile, what Capacitor copies into the app) has key/credential hits: none; server canaries baked: none. Native sources (apps/web/ios, apps/web/android, 40 text files): pattern hits none; google-services.json / GoogleService-Info.plist: none. The TestFlight IPA and the Play AAB/APK themselves are not scanned (needs the CI artefacts from Tim, plus apktool/aapt, not installed).

还要（needs）：IPA + AAB/APK from CI (Tim); set aside for the dev run (iOS/Android)

证据：附了 3 个。

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — Set aside on dev (Quinn 2026-10-14): iOS and Android are left out of the dev run, and this unpacks the TestFlight IPA and the Play AAB/APK.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
